about.h31: Our team, specialized in growing online presence, stands out for its detailed, hands-on work with our clients, delivering results efficiently and on time
about.h32: At Zumia Solutions, we offer complete web development and marketing solutions tailored to our clients' needs.
about.h33: We are committed to helping our clients reach their goals. With us, you can rest assured you'll receive a reliable, quality service.
about.h34: To support micro and small businesses with clear, fast and measurable web and marketing solutions, focused on turning curious visitors into contacts with potential to become customers.

about.h37: We work hand in hand with our clients to build lasting relationships based on trust, transparency and personal attention.

services.title: Your website, from start to <1>finish</1>
services.lead: We design, publish and maintain your business website, with clear plans and hands-on work alongside you. Pick a plan and add the extra tools you need.

process.title: How we <1>work</1>
process.lead: Seven clear steps, from our first conversation to your live website.
process.step1Text: We talk about your business and work out a plan.
process.step2Text: We sign the contract and you pay 50% to get started.
process.step3Text: You send us your texts, images, logo and access details.
process.step4Text: We design and build your site with your brand.
process.step5Text: You review the site and approve it or request adjustments.
process.step6Text: Once you approve, you pay the remaining 50%.
process.step7Text: We publish your website and follow up on it.

extras.title: Add what you <1>need</1>
extras.lead: Each tool adds business days to your plan's delivery.
extras.discount: Discount on tools and on additional subpages or sections: {{esencial}}: {{esencialPct}}% · {{alamedida}}: {{alamedidaPct}}% · {{profesional}}: {{profesionalPct}}%
extras.externalNote: Some tools rely on external services (for example AI, messaging, payment gateways, databases or domains) whose costs are paid by the client. They may vary depending on the solution, and we will let you know when we quote.

redesign.desc: We refresh the design of your current website. The price starts from a base amount and may go up if the project is very large; we confirm it in writing.

external.desc: We add our extra tools to a website we did not build. A one-time surcharge applies, and plan discounts do not.

additional.desc: Add more subpages (each with its own visual hook) or more sections to your website. They are priced per unit and get your plan's discount.
